acceptance_criteria.text: A loaded persisted Study displays dataset and source identity from that saved run's immutable run_config and dataset_manifest, separately from the editable current draft; switching context, restoring a run, and validating a new draft never relabel old outputs.
A newly created or completed Study run appears in the adjacent persisted Results list without manual refresh, and its terminal status and artifact count agree across list/detail projections.
Code Library validation and save operations are bound to the exact source, output contract and base CodeVersion snapshot that was validated; late responses cannot certify changed drafts.

Reload, explicit cancel, snapshot/latest rerun, return and result promotion remain recoverable and operate on the selected persisted run's immutable source/config/manifest, never current draft fallbacks. Closing a view does not cancel a durable run.

A Strategy-owned Study-only browser journey covers normal-user validate/run, automatic Results arrival, accurate artifacts, and draft-versus-saved identity; the complete unchanged full local profile and exact-source CI remain required before readiness.

Preserve all original 18 roadmap criteria and accepted checkpoint history; retain honest limits and disabled native/forward/broker/capital/provider-live scopes. Full platform profile and any Root-owned genuine target acceptance remain distinct and open.

History/profile-backed Dashboard widgets use the shared preparation coordinator before local reads, submit comparison datasets independently, report per-target outcomes, and fence obsolete symbol/timeframe contexts without cancelling durable work.

Dashboard search keeps prefix results as identity-bearing candidates; it resolves only a unique exact match from complete discovery or an explicit candidate choice, and failed symbol/comparison saves retain the prior configuration with visible retry feedback.
Dashboard layout-save failures restore the saved arrangement, explain the failure, and allow a retry that reconciles the visible layout with the server.
